response.query: What statistical power analyses and blind-trial protocols (sample sizes, positive/negative controls, randomization, stopping rules) are required to validate composite-bow diagnostics robustly?
response.answer: To validate composite-bow diagnostics robustly, use large sample sizes, positive and negative controls, strict randomization, and predefined stopping rules. Follow-up studies with rigorous statistical power analyses are essential. Blind-trial protocols ensure unbiased results.
